# Project Title:
# End-to-End Energy Consumption Forecasting and Load Balancing using Pandas, Prophet, and Time Series Cross-Validation
# Project Ref: ai-ml-ds-XyEzPq58Nkt
# Filename: energy_consumption_forecasting_load_balancing.py

from typing import Tuple, List, Dict, Union
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from prophet import Prophet
from sklearn.metrics import mean_absolute_error, mean_squared_error
from sklearn.model_selection import TimeSeriesSplit
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import logging
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')
logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
sns.set_style("whitegrid")

# === DataLoader Component ===
class EnergyDataLoader:
    def __init__(self, url: str):
        self.url: str = url

    def load(self) -> pd.DataFrame:
        df: pd.DataFrame = pd.read_csv(self.url, parse_dates=['Datetime'])
        df = df[['Datetime', 'Energy_consumption']].rename(columns={'Datetime': 'ds', 'Energy_consumption': 'y'})
        df = df.sort_values('ds')
        return df

# === Preprocessor Component ===
class EnergyPreprocessor:
    def __init__(self):
        pass

    def resample_hourly(self, df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
        df_resampled: pd.DataFrame = df.set_index('ds').resample('H').sum().reset_index()
        return df_resampled

    def clean(self, df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
        df = df.dropna()
        df = df[df['y'] > 0]
        return df

# === TimeSeries Model Component ===
class EnergyForecaster:
    def __init__(self):
        self.model: Prophet = Prophet()

    def train(self, df: pd.DataFrame) -> Prophet:
        self.model.fit(df)
        return self.model

    def predict(self, periods: int, freq: str = 'H') -> pd.DataFrame:
        future: pd.DataFrame = self.model.make_future_dataframe(periods=periods, freq=freq)
        forecast: pd.DataFrame = self.model.predict(future)
        return forecast

# === Cross-Validation Evaluator ===
class TimeSeriesEvaluator:
    def __init__(self, splits: int = 5):
        self.splits: int = splits

    def evaluate(self, df: pd.DataFrame) -> Dict[str, float]:
        tscv = TimeSeriesSplit(n_splits=self.splits)
        errors: List[float] = []
        for train_index, test_index in tscv.split(df):
            train, test = df.iloc[train_index], df.iloc[test_index]
            model: Prophet = Prophet()
            model.fit(train)
            future = model.make_future_dataframe(periods=len(test), freq='H')
            forecast = model.predict(future)
            y_true: np.ndarray = test['y'].values
            y_pred: np.ndarray = forecast.iloc[-len(test):]['yhat'].values
            errors.append(mean_absolute_error(y_true, y_pred))
        return {'mae': np.mean(errors)}

# === Load Balancing Optimizer ===
class LoadBalancer:
    def __init__(self, max_capacity: float):
        self.max_capacity: float = max_capacity

    def optimize(self, forecast_df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
        df: pd.DataFrame = forecast_df[['ds', 'yhat']].copy()
        df['load_balanced'] = df['yhat'].apply(lambda y: min(y, self.max_capacity))
        return df

# === Visualizer ===
class ForecastVisualizer:
    def plot(self, original: pd.DataFrame, forecast: pd.DataFrame) -> None:
        plt.figure(figsize=(15, 6))
        plt.plot(original['ds'], original['y'], label='Original')
        plt.plot(forecast['ds'], forecast['yhat'], label='Forecast')
        plt.legend()
        plt.title('Energy Consumption Forecast')
        plt.xlabel('Time')
        plt.ylabel('Energy')
        plt.show()

# === Main Application Class ===
class EnergyForecastingSystem:
    def __init__(self, dataset_url: str):
        self.loader: EnergyDataLoader = EnergyDataLoader(dataset_url)
        self.preprocessor: EnergyPreprocessor = EnergyPreprocessor()
        self.forecaster: EnergyForecaster = EnergyForecaster()
        self.evaluator: TimeSeriesEvaluator = TimeSeriesEvaluator(splits=3)
        self.visualizer: ForecastVisualizer = ForecastVisualizer()
        self.load_balancer: LoadBalancer = LoadBalancer(max_capacity=1500.0)

    def run(self) -> None:
        df: pd.DataFrame = self.loader.load()
        df = self.preprocessor.clean(df)
        df = self.preprocessor.resample_hourly(df)

        self.forecaster.train(df)
        forecast_df: pd.DataFrame = self.forecaster.predict(periods=72)

        eval_scores: Dict[str, float] = self.evaluator.evaluate(df)
        print("Evaluation MAE:", eval_scores['mae'])

        balanced_df: pd.DataFrame = self.load_balancer.optimize(forecast_df)

        self.visualizer.plot(df, forecast_df)
        self.visualizer.plot(df, balanced_df)

# === Example Inputs and Expected Outputs ===
# Input: Dataset URL from UCI or public repository with [Datetime, Energy_consumption] format
# Output: Evaluation score, Forecasted values, Load balanced forecasted plot

if __name__ == '__main__':
    dataset_url: str = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jbrownlee/Datasets/master/household_power_consumption_days.csv"
    system: EnergyForecastingSystem = EnergyForecastingSystem(dataset_url=dataset_url)
    system.run()
